notes:
Overview: Sentinel HelpFlow is an omnichannel customer support platform for mid-market retailers (marketplaces + direct-to-consumer brands). They want to replace brittle macros and cobbled webhook scripts with a stable agent-assist layer that can call internal support systems via APIs (create/update tickets, issue refunds through payment gateway, escalate to fraud team).

Key requirements / constraints:
- Workloads: high volume ticketing during seasonal spikes (Black Friday). Primary flows: ticket triage (create/update), refund orchestration (payment gateway + ledger), automated escalations to fraud/ops. Also agent summarization and suggested reply drafts.
- Latency targets: interactive agent assist p95 <= 250ms for model decisioning; ticket-creation tool-calls acceptable async but end-to-end agent flow target < 2s for UI handoff.
- Throughput: baseline 50-100 reqs/s, spike target 400+ reqs/s sustained for short windows.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-range; willing to pay for predictable capacity during spikes (reserved) but expects tooling to reduce token waste.
- Models: prefer open model stack with quantized variants; need fallbacks to cheaper model tier for non-sensitive routing.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logging for tool-calls, KMS-managed keys for any tokenized payment interactions, strict retention policy for PII, and PCI scoping for refunds flow.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2025-11-20: initial inbound via webinar signup (AE outreach).
- 2025-12-03: discovery call w/ Rina Patel + VP Product (notes in Drive - discovery recap).
- 2026-01-08: demo: hosted API + tool-call diagram; recorded (ff_2026-01-08_prod-demo-9a2b).
- 2026-02-11: POC kickoff meeting: agreed scope = ticket create/update + refund orchestration + fraud escalation. (ff_2026-02-11_venue-45f3).
- 2026-02-20: security questionnaire submitted; waiting on PCI scoping confirmation.
- 2026-02-28: replay dataset (100k tickets) uploaded to staging for performance run; SE has a run scheduled next week.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- Reliable tool-calls to Ticketing API (idempotent creates/updates) with <0.1% error on 100k replay.
- Refund flow completes end-to-end in staging with proper audit trail and masked PII (demo ledger entries + payment gateway ack).
- Spike test: sustain 400req/s for 10 minutes with 95th latency below 800ms for tool-call orchestration (non-blocking to agent UI).
- Security sign-off: SAML mapping validated, KMS integration tested, PCI scope documented.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We absolutely cannot have phantom refunds—any automated refund must have an auditable transaction and a manual override path." — Rina Patel (Head of Support Eng).
- "If you can show consistent performance during a 100k-ticket replay, procurement will move faster." — VP Product.

Technical notes / POC details:
- Integration surface: Ticketing system has REST API (OAuth2 service account) + idempotency keys. Payment provider is partner-managed gateway with refund API; PCI boundaries currently in-scope for Redwood Private or Dedicated with KMS.
- Desired tool-calling behavior: Redwood runtime should orchestrate a transaction: 1) validate ticket 2) call payment refund with retry/backoff 3) update ticket with refund metadata 4) emit audit event to logging service. Must support atomic-ish rollback semantics or compensating actions.
- Observability reqs: token-level cost, per-tool-call latency breakdown, per-route error rates; must be surfaced in Console for on-call engineers.

Next steps (short):
- SE (Diego) to run 100k ticket replay with current dedicated config (scheduled wk of 2026-03-07).
- Security to provide PCI scoping guidance; confirm if Dedicated SLA + KMS suffices or Private required.
- AE (Sofia) to lock in procurement cadence: target decision by 2026-05.

Open items / blockers (short bullets):
- SAML attribute mapping for service accounts (affects audit user mapping).
- Final PCI scoping — will determine Dedicated vs Private.
- Need explicit fallback policy for model-cost vs fidelity (which prompts route to cheaper model during spikes).

Artifacts / refs: POC deck, security FAQ (Drive), two Fireflies recordings, staging replay dataset path (internal).
notes_summary: Evaluation POC for ticket tool-calling + refunds. Focus: reliable, auditable tool-calls during spikes; security/PCI scoping blocks procurement. SE to run 100k-ticket replay; target decision 2026-05.
previous_deal_notes: No prior Redwood usage. Ran a short eval with another vendor last year; failed on PCI/state mapping. Looking for stronger audit controls and predictable spike behavior.
preferred_contract_notes: Prefer annual reserved capacity for Black Friday window + burst credits; want committed throughput SLA and shared runbook for failover to cheaper model tier.
recommended_redwood_playbook: Offer Dedicated with VPC + KMS, propose spike testing plan (100k replay) and a security workshop to scope PCI. Include Optimize recommendations for batching/caching to reduce token spend. Suggest canary rollout for refunds tool-calls with manual approval gate.
